topic: Online Fee Collection via Payment Gateway
summary: Explains how to collect fees online through an integrated payment gateway, allowing parents to pay using various modes like UPI, net banking, or credit card, often via a dynamic QR code.
navigation: Fee > collect fee > (select student) > Collect Online Fees (button)
steps: Ensure the payment gateway is integrated.
On the "collect fee" page, after selecting the student, click on the "Collect Online Fees" option.
The system will present payment options (UPI, Net Banking, Credit Card).
Select a payment mode (e.g., UPI) to generate a dynamic QR code.
Parents can scan the QR code using payment apps (e.g., Paytm, Google Pay) to complete the payment within the specified time limit.
business_rules: Payment gateway integration is required for this feature.
Dynamic QR codes have a time validity.
important_notes: The system can generate dynamic QR codes for UPI payments.
